name: Aervion
summary: Crisp white-and-stone studio site for a solo product designer: heavy tight Inter headlines, warm grey cards, LED dot-matrix index numbers and a single acid lime dot as the only colour.

fonts.pairing: Inter 600 at -0.05em for oversized headlines, Inter 400 body in mid grey, LED Dot dot-matrix face for small index numerals

signature: three-column meta strip of small uppercase labels above the headline, ruled off with a hairline
left-aligned 88px headline in three stacked lines, then a wide 24px-radius portrait photo with a frosted caption chip
dot-matrix 01 to 06 numerals in the corner of each stone service card, balanced by a black dot
acid lime used only as tiny status dots and one blurred glow in the dark closing banner
footer ending in an edge-to-edge 318px wordmark
imagery: soft natural-light portrait in a studio, clean product still lifes (sneaker, bicycle, phone, vegetables) on muted grounds
layout_grid: 1200px canvas, 32px side padding, 120px section padding, 2-column project grid, 3-column service grid, 4-column logo grid
